posts.title: AoC 2024: A Powerful Elixir
posts.description: Each year for Advent of Code I complete the puzzles in a language that I’ve never used before. This year I hastily decided on Elixir, a functional language that runs on the Erlang VM (called BEAM), at the last minute. (I used Zig in 2023, Common Lisp in 2022, Crystal in 2021, and Julia in 2020.)
